title: Entralink flower tiles
description: The flower tiles of each Entree Forest clearing, where a run's hidden item may lie (run.json's hidden_item_chance; docs/paperwhite2/design/entralink-roguelike-prototype.md, Step 6). Generated from the clearings' map models by tools/paperwhite2/entralink_flowers.py (the faces with a flower texture) and editable: the editor shows them on the room grid and toggles them. tools/paperwhite2/entralink_run.py packs it for the game.

items.description: x, z: a flower tile on the clearings' shared 32 by 32 grid

^ZONE_ENTREE_FOREST(_[0-9]+)?$.description: A clearing's flower tiles, by its zone
